title: ScintestRawExperimentRecord
description: Schema for raw laboratory experiment records ingested by VAULT.

clause_id.description: Clause identifier referencing the governing SOP requirement.

sop_version.description: Explicit SOP version if recorded by analyst.

instrument_id.description: Instrument identifier used for analytical measurement.

measured_value.description: Numeric measurement reported by the instrument or analyst.

measurement_unit.description: Reported unit of measurement (e.g. mg/L, ug/L, CFU/g, EU/mL).

collected_at.description: Sample collection timestamp (ISO 8601, timezone-aware or with site timezone).

analyzed_at.description: Sample analysis timestamp (ISO 8601, timezone-aware or with site timezone).

max_holding_hours.description: Maximum allowable holding time in hours between collection and analysis.

sample_matrix.description: Matrix type (e.g., Surface Water, Drinking Water, Wastewater, Soil).

method_id.description: Specific analytical method identifier if documented (standard or alternative).

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the original raw record payload.

original_verdict.description: Analyst's or instrument's originally claimed verdict if present (PASS, FAIL).
